<description>
As the SAM protocol accepts a `.b32.i2p` address as the `DESTINATION` parameter for the `STREAM CONNECT` command, the `NAMING LOOKUP` round trip can be skipped on every outbound connection.

This should ostensibly make failure handling more accurate in certain situations as well, since a peer that cannot be resolved now returns `CANT_REACH_PEER`/`TIMEOUT` rather than there being an empty `VALUE=` key in the lookup reply. A missing `VALUE=` is a proxy error, so the attempt isn't recorded in AddrMan.

Router implementation versions that support this (Java I2P 0.9.48, i2pd 2.38.0) are older than ones supporting `i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4` (see #35696), so there should be no compatibility issues here.

Source:
https://i2p.net/en/docs/api/samv3/#sam-virtual-streams-connect
</description>

-        const Reply& lookup_reply =
-            SendRequestAndGetReply(*sock, strprintf("NAMING LOOKUP NAME=%s", to.ToStringAddr()));

-
         const Reply& connect_reply = SendRequestAndGetReply(
-            *sock, strprintf("STREAM CONNECT ID=%s DESTINATION=%s SILENT=false", session_id, dest),
+            *sock, strprintf("STREAM CONNECT ID=%s DESTINATION=%s SILENT=false", session_id, to.ToStringAddr()),

         const std::string& result = connect_reply.Get("RESULT");
